title: Samvad AI — Aditya University Parent Admissions Desk Video Demo Narration

sections.title: Section 1 — Introduction & The Aditya University Problem
sections.action: Start on homepage. Show header logo, problem headline, voice audition chips, and Gnani attribution.
sections.script: Hello respected evaluators! I am Gowtham, presenting Samvad AI — an autonomous parent admissions and student counseling agent built for Aditya University. During B.Tech admissions season, our agent handles high-volume parent inquiries, explains our NAAC A++ accreditation, and guides families through our 180-acre Surampalem campus.

sections.title: Section 2 — Live Admissions Dashboard & Parent Advisory
sections.action: Navigate to Dashboard. Highlight Admissions Desk (+91 98765 43210), 6 live metrics, and Upcoming & Recorded calling lists.
sections.script: Here is the live Admissions Dashboard for Aditya University. The agent operates autonomously, advising parents on four-year B.Tech programs in CSE, AI and Machine Learning, Data Science, and ECE. In our prototype mode, all parent consultations are pre-calibrated with verified Gnani Timbre neural voices.

sections.title: Section 3 — Authentic Parent Consultations & Dual Voice Dialogue
sections.action: Click Consultations. Hit Play on a call to hear contrasting officer (Shivani) & Telugu parent voices with natural 400ms pauses.
sections.script: In Recordings, every call features authentic multi-turn counseling between our officer Shivani and real Telugu parents — both Fathers and Mothers — with natural four hundred millisecond pauses. Parents ask deep questions about our Industry 4.0 curriculum, Technical Hub coding, and hostel security, with strict gender-accurate honorifics.

sections.title: Section 4 — Admissions Daily Brief & Lead Card
sections.action: Click Play on Spoken Admissions Brief (<60 words). Click 'View lead card' to show EAPCET rank, branch, & one-click WhatsApp.
sections.script: At day end, the admissions office listens to our Spoken Daily Brief under sixty words, synthesized with Gnani Timbre, highlighting confirmed admissions and campus counseling visits. Clicking any parent opens their structured Lead Card with EAPCET ranks and one-click WhatsApp follow-ups.

sections.title: Section 5 — Sovereign AI Voice Catalog & Performance
sections.action: Click Settings. Show 10 Indian Language Modes, 16+ Timbre voices, SQLite zero-billing cache, and close with a final thank you!
sections.script: In Settings, our system leverages Gnani Prisma STT and Gnani Timbre TTS across 10 Indian language modes with over 16 verified voices. All audio files and transcripts are cached in SQLite for zero duplicate billing and instantaneous playback. Thank you!
